rawRecord.short_description: Integrates with Google Calendar and Google Sheets through a hosted service with OAuth login.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides access to Google Calendar and Google Sheets through a hosted streamable HTTP endpoint. Supports listing calendars, creating and managing events, checking availability, reading and writing spreadsheet data, searching rows, and creating new spreadsheets. Uses proxy OAuth authentication so users do not need to set up their own Google Cloud projects.
